description: Every item our collectors observed for the current publication day, newest first. Preliminary until the end-of-day gates freeze the dated digest, which is the record. Additive change only.

counts.description: whole-day observation counts by collection/doc_type, backfill included

day_context.description: null on federal business days; on weekends/federal holidays an object {kind, name, note} explaining why the stream may be short

facets.description: tags: keyword -> item count; note: how to filter client-side

items.description: ALL observed items including backfill — filter on is_backfill=false to match the human page's listing

corroborated_by.description: on a listed item: the OTHER ingestion channels the same document (same canonical URL) arrived through — independent receipt, not a content judgment

duplicate_of.description: on a non-listed item: the package_id of the listed twin; the human pages show that one entry, marked corroborated — filter these out to match the human listing

is_backfill.description: true = the publisher dates this item on another day (claimed_day); not part of this day's news

official_url.description: the item's own captured URL, or the govinfo details page for govinfo collections; null for an email bulletin with no URL

opening_verbatim.description: first ~240 chars of the official text, unedited

summary_method.description: official = agency/GPO text; llm = model-generated, labeled

tags.description: mechanical (branch, document type, agency); no model-generated item tags yet

labels.description: the honesty disclosures for this file, keyed by the field each explains — the same text as this schema's descriptions

pending_llm.description: items awaiting a model layer; additive, not an error count

title: today.json — the live, PRELIMINARY publication day
